name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Taiwan practices war games as it fears increasing Chinese aggression, questions Trump's support
changes.summary: Taiwan continued its 10-day war games this weekend, preparing for a potential invasion by China, which claims the territory as its own and has threatened to seize it by force. Anna Coren has more details from Taiwan.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The Trump administration has backed plans to build an Australian scandium mine as part of a push to challenge China’s critical-minerals dominance.

changes.title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
changes.summary: Lindell, of "MyPillow," plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents. (Image credit: Dana Ferguson).

changes.title: Trump is still searching for a way out of Iran
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is struggling to find a way out of the conflict with Iran, as voters lose patience with the war and weapons stockpiles dwindle. The path forward remains unclear, even as Trump has privately weighed dropping his long-held requirement for a nuclear deal. Washington is unlikely to accept Iran’s late.

changes.title: Trump says oil supermajors are making too much money. What will they do with it?
changes.summary: The windfall is fueling fresh political and environmental backlash, with Trump accusing Exxon Mobil and Chevron of making “too much money.”.

changes.title: Politics chat: Progressive candidates in primaries, Trump's influence on midterms
changes.summary: Republicans are trying to hang fringe positions on Democrats but may not be able to withstand the economic headwinds in November's midterms.

changes.title: Netanyahu rejects Gaza peace plan, vows no military withdrawal until Hamas disarms
changes.summary: President Trump hailed the peace plan​ as a "historic agreement for the complete disarmament of Hamas and all other groups in Gaza.".

changes.title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
changes.summary: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency. (Image credit: KENT NISHIMURA).

changes.title: Will Darline Graham face the same fate Pamela Evette did in South Carolina?
changes.summary: South Carolina Republicans might be watching history repeat itself. A special election Senate primary on Tuesday, triggered by Sen. Lindsey Graham’s sudden death, has all the makings of their rollercoaster governor’s primary back in June: A front-runner endorsed by President Donald Trump but facing a steep uphill battl.

changes.title: Trump's immigration crackdown looms over Minnesota's bruising Senate primary
changes.summary: Months later, confrontations between immigration agents and protestors in Minneapolis remain the backdrop to Minnesota's Democratic primary for U.S. Senate on Tuesday, which features establishment-backed U.S. Rep. Angie Craig and the more progressive Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan.
